name: universal-rate-limiter
description: A lightweight universal rate limiter for frontend and backend — works in Browser, Node.js, Express, Next.js Middleware, and React.
author: Joseph Maina <mainajm254@gmail.com> (https://github.com/MainaJoseph)

scripts.test:vanilla: npm run build && echo 'Open examples/vanilla/index.html in your browser'
scripts.ci:check-size: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');console.log('Package size analysis:');const distPath='dist';if(fs.existsSync(distPath)){fs.readdirSync(distPath).forEach(f=>{const stats=fs.statSync(path.join(distPath,f));const sizeKB=(stats.size/1024).toFixed(2);console.log(f+': '+sizeKB+' KB')});console.log('Size check completed')}else{console.log('dist/ not found')}"
